subject: Post-demo security handshake: pen test report request & vuln management ramp
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-14T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo security handshake: pen test report request & vuln management ramp

Hi Alex — great to demo earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance items we talked through:

- SOC 2 / HIPAA: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2026; we also maintain HIPAA controls where customers require it (BAA available). I attached a 1-page SOC2 summary and our vendor security questionnaire template to start your intake.
- Pen test: you asked about previous penetration test outcomes and timeline for a new test. We can share a redacted pen test summary (we'll provide an appropriate redacted PDF) and propose an annual third-party pentest plus quarterly automated scans.
- Vulnerability management & disclosure: proposed SLA below (we're flexible, open to negotiation):
    * Critical: 15 business days to provide remediation plan, 30 business days for mitigation where possible
    * High: 30 business days for mitigation plan
    * Medium/Low: tracked in backlog with standard release cadence
- Disclosure: we support coordinated disclosure, will redact sensitive customer data, and can agree to a 30-day public disclosure window by default (can be shortened for escalations).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm which artifacts you need (full redacted pen test, SOC 2 report, BAA)
2) We'll initiate vendor questionnaire intake — please review the attached template and highlight any additional asks
3) If ok, schedule a 30m follow-up to align on SLA and cadence (Connor will help run the MAP)

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2026-summary.pdf, vendor_security_template.xlsx

Thanks — Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai | tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@medsyshealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@medsyshealth.com
Date: 2027-09-15T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security handshake: pen test report request & vuln management ramp

Tessa — thanks for the summary and the template. A couple of clarifying asks from our security team: 

1) Can you provide the redacted pen test report (or summary) from your last 3rd-party test? We need the findings and remediation status to qualify risk.
2) For SOC 2, we need either the attestation or a customer-facing summary and confirmation of the scope (in-scope systems/services).
3) Vendor questionnaire: we'll start with the attached intake — I expect around ~40 fields. Can you confirm who will be our point of contact for follow-up?
4) SLA/Disclosure: our security ops prefers a 30-day remediation SLA for critical items with a mandatory 72-hour incident notification window. Are you able to commit to 72-hour notification to our security_ops@medsyshealth.com for incidents affecting PHI or production outages?

If you can share the pen test summary and SOC2 materials, we can move to a quick risk review. Also, please include any redaction policy for pen test reports (we often require redaction of customer IP and specific exploit POC details).

Cheers,
Alex Rivera
Sr. Security Architect — MedSys Health
alex.rivera@medsyshealth.com

Alex — appreciate the clear asks. Per the requests below, attaching the artifacts we can share immediately and summarizing our positions: 

Attachments in this message: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (attestation summary), PenTest_Summary_redwood_2026.pdf (redacted findings + remediation status). Both are redacted to remove customer-identifying info and detailed exploit POC. If you need more granular technical details we can run a controlled disclosure with you under an NDA or coordinate with our infosec team.

Point of contact: Connor O'Brien (cc'd) will be the lead on questionnaire intake and MAP coordination. He'll own follow-ups and scheduling.

SLA & notifications:
- Incident notification: Redwood will notify MedSys security_ops@medsyshealth.com within 72 hours for incidents affecting PHI or production availability.
- Remediation SLA (proposed baseline, we can agree in MAP):
    * Critical (RCE, data-exfil, PHI exposure): remediation plan within 15 business days, mitigation timeline target 30 business days; prioritized hotfix channels available for emergency fixes
    * High: remediation plan within 30 business days
    * Medium/Low: tracked per release cycle

Scanning cadence:
- Continuous automated scans (weekly/light scans) with triage
- Quarterly internal vulnerability scans (credentialed)
- Annual 3rd-party penetration test (scope aligned with in-scope services)

Disclosure & redaction: Standard practice is coordinated disclosure with a 30-day public window; we will redact customer identifiers and detailed exploit steps. For your internal assessments we can provide more detail under an NDA.

Next steps:
1) Connor will send over a MAP link and proposed calendar windows for a 30m alignment call
2) Please confirm receipt of the two attachments and whether you need the full SOC 2 attestation (we can provide under an MSA/BAA if required)

Links: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-Redwood-MAP

Best,
Tessa
